notes: Keyed by CAPABILITY SIGNATURE, never by chipset/vendor name. All match fields are derivable from core/detector.sh outputs (device.txt: CPU_POLICIES, GOVS, THERMAL, THERMAL_W) plus one live writability check (devfreq max_freq/governor). First matching signature wins. profile_hints are LOGICAL values (percents, governor preference order, thermal class) — OPP/frequency mapping happens in the apply layer, not here.

signatures.name: managed-performance
signatures.description: Multi-policy CPU, performance governor available, writable GPU devfreq, at least one thermal zone.

signatures.name: managed-balanced
signatures.description: CPU with schedutil, writable GPU devfreq, at least one thermal zone.

signatures.name: light-touch
signatures.description: Minimal known capability: at least one CPU policy. No GPU or thermal assumptions.

default_fallback.description: Safest values for fully unknown capability. Used when no signature matches; always logged.
